_meta.verified_policy: verified is false for every entry until a live test-mode run observes the documented error code coming back from the API. The 2026-08-31 run observed none of them, so every entry is still false and each one records what came back instead.
_meta.open_question: Resolved on 2026-08-31, and not the way it was asked. There is no card that forces a successful authorization. The outcome is chosen at the last step of the checkout sequence through a single form field carrying S or F, and the same card number produced both a captured payment and a failed one. success_cards stays empty because the concept does not apply.
_meta.mode: test mode only. These numbers do nothing on live keys.
_meta.live_walk_2026_08_31: All eight cards were driven through the checkout sequence in docs/RAZORPAY-TEST-MODE-NOTES.md, one order each, with the mock bank told to decline. Every one produced the identical failure: error_reason payment_failed, error_code BAD_REQUEST_ERROR, error_source gateway, error_step payment_authorization. The card number does not reach the mock bank in a form that changes what it returns. This does not establish that the documented codes are wrong, only that the one mechanism that works without a browser does not reproduce them.
_meta.risk_block: Resolved on 2026-09-01, and not from a run. The live-mode card error documentation names the reason: payment_risk_check_failed. testcards.PendingRiskBlockCode is gone and internal/classify carries the documented string. No risk block has still ever been produced by a call from this project, so the reason is documented and not observed. PRD Q2 closed.

labels.documented-test-mode: A card number or VPA the Razorpay test-card page publishes. Cited by the source field on the row. It says nothing about live mode, where these numbers do nothing.
labels.observed-test-mode: A value this project observed coming back from Razorpay test mode and which appears on no documentation page.

_meta.live_mode_vocabulary: The error_code on each row is the string the test-card page carries, which is not always the live-mode string. insufficient_fund below is spelled insufficient_funds in the live-mode card error documentation, and card_number_invalid is not on the live-mode card list at all. testdata/error_codes.json holds both vocabularies with a label on every row, and internal/classify keeps them in separate tables.
